summary: Counts wrapped text items up to the cursor position. Reads the source text pointer at this+0xE0 (falling back to a default string global when null), then iterates via MenuCursorNavigationHelper from index 0, incrementing a counter until no further wrap occurs, the cursor limit at this+0xE4 is reached, or an end-of-string delimiter (byte 0xFF) is hit.

operations.description: Read source text pointer stored at this+0xE0 and dereference it
When the dereferenced text pointer is null, fall back to the default string global byte_5EA438
Compute text length as strlen(v2) plus 1
Iterate cursor indices via MenuCursorNavigationHelper(this, i) starting from 0, advancing i to the value returned by the helper
Break loop when index is unchanged, when the cursor limit at this+0xE4 is below the wrapped position, or when at end of string with the previous character not being the 0xFF delimiter
Increment the line/item counter on each wrapped position before the break conditions

unresolved: Exact meaning of the cursor limit at this+0xE4 and whether the count is of text lines or of wrapped segments is not established.
